answer: Each identity locks 80 credits to a lamp; its beacon logs each at dawn. The bond decays on a spiral schedule: 5 in epoch 1, then 6, 7, rising by 1 each epoch; an untopped lamp darkens by epoch 10. Auditors replay the beacon's dawn log: a dark lamp loses its bond; one key on many lamps exposes a rented-lamp farm. 1,000 fakes cost 80,000 locked, 95,000 top-ups: 175,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents top up 5 to 14 per epoch; one lamp stays lit.
